notes.title: Exelio – Craft-Survival Adventure Shows Latest Playable at Tokyo Game Show 2025
notes.content:
[p]AI Frog Interactive will exhibit the latest playable build of the single-player craft-survival game [b]“Exelio”[/b] in the [b]Indie Game Area at Tokyo Game Show 2025[/b], featuring newly added elements.
Booth No.: [b]Indie Game Area 11-C23[/b][/p][p]We will also begin rolling out [b]captured gameplay videos from the opening section[/b] on our [b]Steam store page[/b] and [b]official YouTube[/b]. In parallel, we are [b]adjusting the Early Access launch window to the first half of 2026[/b] to further raise overall completeness and player experience.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]This TGS 2025 Showcase[/b][/h3][list][*][p][b]Latest playable on site:[/b] Hands-on on [b]Steam Deck[/b] with major improvements to controls and the early game.[/p][/*][*][p][b]“New features” footage released in stages:[/b] During TGS, we will publish gameplay videos covering the start through early progression on [b]Steam / YouTube / X (formerly Twitter)[/b].[/p][/*][*][p][b]Early Access moved to “1H 2026”:[/b] To secure time for polish, content expansion, and optimization.[/p][/*][/list][h3][b]Highlights of Additions / Improvements (Latest Build)[/b][/h3][list][*][p][b]Major overhaul of core systems:[/b] Based on feedback, the [b]fatigue system[/b] has been reworked and [b]shifted to a time-limit system[/b], alongside a significant [b]UI refresh[/b].[/p][/*][*][p][b]Improved game tempo:[/b] Clearer guidance in the early game through stronger player direction.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Expanded crafting:[/b] Strengthened the flow from [b]resources → materials → facilities → base[/b]; [b]missions[/b] and [b]assist features[/b] make crafting easier.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Faster base construction:[/b] Revised [b]building UI[/b] and [b]snap behavior[/b]; enhanced base-development functions.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Refined night raids:[/b] Adjusted “detection” feedback (sound, light, footprints, etc.) and [b]overhauled combat[/b].[/p][/*][*][p][b]Voice test added:[/b] Added select [b]voice lines[/b] on a trial basis in response to frequent requests.[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: The world of planet EXELIO
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45206185/d4f16c50c32faa9e8564b4b1a339f326507cf8ad.png[/img]

“EXELIO” is a craft-based survival game where you survive in a harsh environment.
The main character, Lion, explores the harsh nature and finds a way out.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45206185/b583cd24f890edced2caf2fd094a44e41a71fce7.png[/img]A sheer cliff with many layers blocks Rion's path.
Still, he ventures into unexplored territory.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45206185/4b5093ef8f8c40b55f17881afe87cfd6da959fe6.png[/img]A beautiful waterfall quenches Lion's throat.
Nature sometimes accepts him.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45206185/bef6edbe7dab3c0d84a2f98a539a3481dacb9c79.png[/img]The forest is full of life.
Although it is a treasure trove of materials, there are also hidden dangers.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45206185/e726650c746a4bfff0411fce656c231e8b8427fc.png[/img]A dimly lit cave swallows intruders.
Should I turn back or move forward? That judgment is also important.


This is the planet EXELIO.
In this beautiful yet cruel world, Rion carves out his own destiny.

notes.title: Survive through crafting
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45206185/07988a41677e5bdf4b256b45d6b673e22c3d0a83.png[/img]

“EXELIO” is a harsh craft survival game.
Lion has great crafting abilities and can create the tools he needs to survive, but to do so he must roam the planet EXELIO and collect materials.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45206185/5de843592cdab6e9d230928324cb0799f279c301.gif[/img]

Next, let's do some crafting with the materials we've gathered.
For example, if you combine “straw" properly, you can create a “bed".

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45206185/0130528e6a00f97fdad7af900a285d7d1d60f4c8.gif[/img]

This is a necessary tool for taking a break, but since there is no roof, there is no protection from the night dew.
Furthermore, by building a “roof (shelter)” and combining it with a “bed”, you can sleep comfortably.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45206185/ee6c2dcbf4f2601ab77e1238b41f038c9ac27a40.gif[/img]

In this way, combining materials to create tools is essential for survival.

[previewyoutube=9NuJsFrFoP4;full][/previewyoutube]
But Lion didn't know it yet.
This planet, EXELIO, is not safe with just a sheltered bed.

notes.title: To the unexplored land
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45206185/6c4f6a8b1e5ce2bee40012fed98be8eaa0526e9f.png[/img]
The landing pod entered the atmosphere and was trying to adjust its landing attitude to EXELIO while slowing down.
However, its trajectory appears to be unstable, and the aircraft trembles due to subtle vibrations, repeating mysterious tilts and rotations. It seems that an unexpected situation has occurred.

The pod's control system had assumed that this anomaly could occur.
“She” was aware that there was far more foreign matter (debris) scattered around the planet's orbit than would normally be expected, and that it was impossible to calculate how to avoid it and invade.
Fuel leaking from some of the destroyed attitude control nozzles, probably caused by debris that crashed at high speed, ignited, taking away some of the landing control functions.

The landing pod, which had prepared its landing policy for a hard landing, began to roar to the silent EXELIO while being engulfed in flames, making its presence known to the ground.

notes.title: Make combos at the right time
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45206185/afa311e4064911eb30c3b267afc98b4c4a50719d.png[/img]
One of the appeals of “EXELIO” is its rugged action.
Selena, one of the main characters, is an expert in combat, so she is skilled at using weapons.
However, if you just hit the button repeatedly, you will inevitably have a hard time fighting a large number of enemies.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45206185/056b4b69a53365b544d14f5f16e551c5d1916a68.gif[/img]

By determining the motion of swinging the sword and pressing the attack button at the right time, you can perform spectacular combos.
Continuous attacks are an important technique for efficiently defeating large numbers of enemies.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45206185/6d63d5125abb1de17f56ea3cc6381928a4140e9e.gif[/img]

This time we introduced attacks with swords, but there are different types of swords, such as two-handed swords and one-handed swords, and each type has a different attack pattern, so fight with the weapon that suits you best.

[previewyoutube=bkNafAAcyxY;full][/previewyoutube]

By the way, there are various types of weapons other than swords, so please look forward to it.

notes.title: Story of the game introduction
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45206185/41fdf310aa7080e03749ddd89134c0b63abc3f04.png[/img]
The stage is set in the Alpha Centauri star system, 4.4 light years from Earth on the unknown planet EXELIO.
A landing pod has just been launched from an exploration ship orbiting the planet, aiming for the ground.
The heat-resistant armor of the landing pod is blackened by the scorching flames caused by friction with the atmosphere, and the intense pressure and heat make the outer shell creak.
The shape of the small capsule, which continued to accelerate as it glided through the launch, looked ominously similar to that of a coffin.

...Amidst the roar, the young explorer Lion lies quietly inside that “coffin”.
He is unconscious and has no way of knowing the impact of the entry or the warning sound, but it is the pod's precise calculating device that controls everything and guides him calmly.

EXELIO - a new place he has arrived at after a long journey.
What awaits him when he awakens from his sleep on this planet?
Is it the promised hope... or an unknown threat?
He will soon be challenged to answer these questions.
His adventure into the unknown is about to begin.

notes.title: Let me introduce the three main characters of the game.
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45206185/fa0ca9afd004ce843eefbaf621f07e393c25a952.png[/img]
[h3][b]LION[/b][/h3]
A young man who lost his purpose due to an accident with his settlement pod. While his combat abilities are not high, he excels in survival skills. 
He explores by utilizing the scattered wreckage and abundant vegetation on the mysterious planet, making full use of his crafting abilities.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45206185/790f7379c500dd35658ba4d1adb187033d6119b5.png[/img]
[h3][b]ARIA[/b][/h3]
A girl who supports Lion.
The real reason why she continues to support him is unclear.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45206185/a50a88991f87c2db32b3102c988e2d7e13e8900f.png[/img]
[h3][b]SELENA[/b][/h3]
A woman somewhere on the mysterious planet. 
She is connected to Lion by the threads of fate, 
but Lion is not yet aware of this.

notes.content:

With a team comprised of staff with extensive experience in the game industry, we will efficiently develop high-quality original games.
